LanguageData.PNA_Addiction.label: PNA Dependence
LanguageData.PNA_Addiction.description: Physical dependence formed after PNA load reaches its maximum, maintaining increased sex drive. After supply stops, recovery advances at no more than 20% load while in withdrawal. Full dependence takes 8 effective recovery days to clear. Further supply does not reset completed progress.
LanguageData.PNA_Addiction.stages.0.label: Dependent
LanguageData.PNA_Addiction.stages.1.label: Withdrawal
